title: Monotonization is coordinatewise monotone
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f$ be a sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube. The function obtained by successively polarizing $f$ in every coordinate is monotone in each coordinate.
hypotheses_covered: A sign-valued function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
